profile.name: Aeroports de Paris SA
profile.summary: Aeroports de Paris SA, together with its subsidiaries, operates and designs airports in France, Turkey, Kazakhstan, Jordan, Georgia, and internationally. It operates in five segments: Aviation; Retail and Services; Real Estate; International and Airport Developments; and Other Activities. The Aviation segment offers airport services, such as landing, parking, and passengers; check-in and boarding counters, baggage handling facilities, de-icing facilities, and the supplying of electricity to aircraft; and security and airport safety services, including security checkpoints and screening systems, aircraft rescue, and fire-fighting services. Its Retail and Services segment is involved in retail activities in terminals comprising retail shops, bars and restaurants, banks and currency exchange offices, and car rentals; commercial distribution; advertising; car parks; production and supply of heat, drinking water, and access to the chilled distribution networks; tourism; luxury passenger services; and construction of metro station. The Real Estate segment engages in property leasing services; construction, commercialization, and lease management of office buildings, logistic buildings, and freight terminals; and rental of serviced land. Its International and Airport Developments segment designs and operates airport activities. The Other Activities segment offers telecom and cybersecurity services. Aeroports de Paris SA was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Tremblay-en-France, France.
profile.summary_fr: Aéroports de Paris SA, avec ses filiales, exploite et conçoit des aéroports en France, en Turquie, au Kazakhstan, en Jordanie, en Géorgie et à l’international. Elle exerce ses activités dans cinq secteurs : aviation; commerce de détail et services; immobilier; développements internationaux et aéroportuaires; et autres activités. Le secteur Aviation offre des services aéroportuaires, tels que l'atterrissage, le stationnement et les passagers; des comptoirs d'enregistrement et d'embarquement, des installations de manutention des bagages, des installations de dégivrage et la fourniture d'électricité aux avions; et des services de sécurité et de sécurité aéroportuaire, y compris des points de contrôle et des systèmes de contrôle de sécurité, des services de sauvetage des avions et des services de lutte contre les incendies.
